title: A Spring Fell Off A Shelf And Became The Slinky 🌀
caption:
A spring fell off a shelf and walked away 🌀
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In 1943 engineer Richard James was working with springs for steadying ship instruments when one fell off a shelf and kept stepping across the floor. He saw a toy. His ship device was a flop, but the Slinky became one of America's best selling toys.
Stairs or no stairs? 👇
first_comment: Everyone has tried it on the stairs. Did yours make it all the way down? 🌀👇
